title: feat: Adaptive Multi-Source Ensemble fusion + Weekly Highlights
body:
## Summary İki büyük değişiklik, tek commit (kapsam dışı bırakılan feedback-loop / Madde 4 dahil değildir): **1. WeatherFusion: statik inverse-spread → Adaptive Multi-Source Ensemble.** METAR mevcutsa artık canlı bir ground-truth anchor olarak füzyona giriyor; modeller gözlemden sapmalarına göre yeniden ağırlıklandırılıyor, basınçta çapraz-kaynak anomali tespiti yapılıyor ve güven tahmin ufkuna göre çürüyor. Tüm yeni alanlar opsiyonel → `ForecastCache` Codable sözleşmesi kırılmıyor. Domain katmanı Foundation-only, hiçbir `!` yok. ``` fuse(keyed, groundTruth?, devicePressureHPa?) gt = FusionGroundTruth(metar: raw) // knots→km/h, inHg→hPa, ageMinutes modelWeights[i] = (1-f) + f * exp(-k * dev_i) // f = exp(-age/30), dev = |ΔT| + |Δwind|/10 + |Δp|/3 anomaly = MAD modified z-score ≥ 3.5 && |x-median| ≥ 3 hPa // suspect source down-weighted/excluded current blend += freshness-scaled METAR anchor // SADECE current; hourly/daily'ye gözlem enjekte edilmez FusionConfidence { agreement, temperatureSpreadC, models, horizonDecay?, anomalyDetected?, anomalySource? } ``` - `HorizonConfidence { shortRange, midRange, longRange }` agreement ile modüle edilir; radar nowcast varsa `withNowcastShortRangeBoost()` ilk bandı sabitler. - Karmaşıklık O(n) korunur (per-model ağırlık vektörü zaten model sayısı kadar). **2. Güven-farkında AI narrative.** `narrative()` ve `/narrative` opsiyonel anonim sinyaller alıyor: `agreement`, `anomaly_detected`, `anomaly_source`, `metar_age_minutes`. Backend özete kısa bir güven cümlesi (TR/EN) ekliyor, system prompt tonu yüksek/düşük güvene göre ayarlıyor. Hiçbir koordinat/kimlik gönderilmiyor. `HomeView` `store.fusionConfidence` + METAR yaşını besliyor. **3. WeeklyHighlightsEngine (yeni) + "Bu Hafta Öne Çıkanlar" kartı.** 7 günlük `hourly` dizilerini tek geçişte (O(n)) tarayıp ardışık yağmur (`>%50`) ve sıcaklık (mutlak 32°C+ veya hafta ort. +5°C) pencerelerini buluyor: ```swift struct WeatherHighlight { kind: .rain/.heat; start: Date; end: Date; peakValue: Double } WeeklyHighlightsEngine.highlights(from: hourly) -> [WeatherHighlight] // start'a göre sıralı, ham model ``` Engine ham olay döndürür (string üretmez); UI lokalize eder ("Çar 14:00–17:00 arası yağmur"). `WeatherStore.weeklyHighlights` olarak publish edilir, Lab/simülasyonda boşaltılır. ## Test / Doğrulama - `deno check`, `deno lint`, `deno fmt` — temiz (util.ts; cache.ts'teki fmt farkı bu PR'a ait değil, dokunulmadı). - Swift: kutuda toolchain yok; CI derleyecek. Manuel review: `import SwiftUI` Domain'e sızmadı, hiç `!` yok, yeni Codable alanları opsiyonel. ## CLAUDE.md Bölüm 2 (akış diyagramı), 4 (WeatherFusion/WeeklyHighlightsEngine satırları + narrative endpoint parametreleri), 5 (FusionGroundTruth, HorizonConfidence, güncel FusionConfidence, WeatherHighlight), 6 (narrative query sinyalleri + cache notu) güncellendi. en/tr `Localizable.strings` anahtarları eklendi. Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/51d7e3ed8f174401908a06a3ebbed530 Requested by: @mehmetg06

Greptile Summary

This PR introduces two major features: an Adaptive Multi-Source Ensemble fusion algorithm that uses live METAR observations as a ground-truth anchor to re-weight NWP models (with cross-source pressure anomaly detection via MAD z-score), and a new `WeeklyHighlightsEngine` that distills the 7-day hourly series into actionable rain/heat event cards shown in `HomeView`. The backend (`util.ts`) gains optional anonymous confidence signals that adjust the AI narrative tone accordingly. - **`WeatherFusion`** is significantly extended with per-model deviation weights, METAR freshness-scaled anchoring, pressure anomaly detection, and horizon-confidence decay — all new optional fields on `FusionConfidence` preserve Codable backward-compatibility. - **`WeeklyHighlightsEngine`** (new file) performs a single O(n) pass over hourly arrays to find contiguous rain/heat windows; the engine is Foundation-only and emits no user-facing strings. - **`deno/util.ts`** appends a one-line confidence summary (TR/EN) to the weather brief sent to the AI and adjusts the system-prompt tone based on agreement percentage, anomaly flag, and METAR age.

Confidence Score: 3/5

Safe to merge after fixing the METAR pressure anchoring in WeatherFusion; all other changes are well-scoped and additive. The METAR altimeter-setting value (QNH, converted from inHg) is anchored to both `pressureMsl` and `surfacePressure` in `fuseCurrent`. QNH is a sea-level reduced pressure and is correct for `pressureMsl`, but `surfacePressure` represents the actual pressure at the station's elevation. At 500 m above sea level the two fields differ by roughly 60 hPa, so the anchor steadily pulls the blended surface pressure toward an incorrect higher reading for the majority of real-world locations. Praeventus.swiftpm/WeatherFusion.swift — the `fuseCurrent` function at line 292 anchors `surfacePressure` with METAR QNH; the HomeView DateFormatter allocation is a secondary concern.

Important Files Changed

| Filename | Overview | |----------|----------| | Praeventus.swiftpm/WeatherFusion.swift | Core fusion engine refactored to Adaptive Multi-Source Ensemble; contains a P1 bug where METAR altimeter setting (QNH/MSL pressure) is incorrectly used to anchor surfacePressure, introducing altitude-dependent bias for non-sea-level locations. | | Praeventus.swiftpm/WeeklyHighlightsEngine.swift | New Foundation-only engine that scans hourly arrays in a single O(n) pass to find rain/heat windows; logic is clean, edge cases (nil dates, missing values, past-hour filtering, time-gap tolerance) are handled correctly. | | Praeventus.swiftpm/HomeView.swift | Adds weeklyHighlightsCard and confidence-aware narrative call; two DateFormatter instances are recreated on every body evaluation inside weeklyHighlightsCard (P2 performance concern), otherwise changes are straightforward. | | Praeventus.swiftpm/WeatherStore.swift | Wires FusionGroundTruth into the fuse call, publishes weeklyHighlights, and correctly clears highlights in simulated Lab states; no issues found. | | deno/util.ts | Adds optional anonymous confidence signals to buildWeatherSummary and narrative system prompt; parameters are optional, defaults are safe (absent anomaly_detected treated as false), no new identity/location data added. | | Praeventus.swiftpm/CloudflareWeatherProvider.swift | Extends narrative() with four optional confidence-signal parameters appended to query items only when non-nil; clean, backward-compatible change. |
